full_judgment:
2. Short facts necessary for disposal of the instant Rule are that the petitioner as plaintiff filed Other Class Suit No. 92 of 1990 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Court No. 13, Naogaon praying for a decree of declaration of title and recovery of khas possession against the principal defendants and asserted that Mohor Chan Shah, Ful Chan Shah, Ray -Chan Shah, Rup Chan Shah and Pushpa Beoa were the original CS recorded owner of CS Khatian No. 134 which is described in "Ka" schedule, and the "Ka" schedule land along with another land was sold in auction in Execution Case No. 178 of 1933 in execution of the decree passed in Title Suit No. 3277 of 1932. Naogaon Co-operative Land Mortgage Bank Ltd purchased the "Ka" schedule property in auction and the said bank by registered deed dated 9-11-1938 sold the same to one Abdul Sardar @ Abdur Rahman, who subsequently transferred 271/2 decimals of land by registered deed dated 25-2-1944 in favour of one Abdul Hye who died leaving behind his only brother Mohammad Miah. Mohammad Miah subsequently died, leaving behind his only son Abdus Sukkur who sold 271/2 decimals of land by registered deed dated 7-5-1953 in favour of one Md. Warhead Hossain, who is the father of defendant No. 7, and SA Khatian No. 136 was prepared in the name of Md. Warhead Hossain, who died leaving behind his son Abdul Mazid (defendant No. 7) and daughter Mahbuba Bibi and RS record was prepared in their name. The defendant No. 7 obtained 20 decimals of land by amicable partition and by registered deed dated 28-4-1973 he transferred 20 decimals of land in favour of the plaintiff, and after purchase, the plaintiff took over possession of his 20 decimals of land. The defendants forcefully dispossessed the plaintiff from "ga" schedule property and hence the suit. 

 3. The defendant Nos. 1 to 6 entered an appearance in the suit by filing written statement and asserted that Md. Wahed Miah was the original owner of 42 decimals of the land of dag Nos. 651,652,653 and 654, and the concerned authority prepared SA Khatian No 136 and 137 in his name. Md. Wahed Miah died leaving behind his son Abdul Mazid and daughter Mahbuban Bibi and RS Khatian Nos. 24 and 25 were prepared in their name. Abdul Mazid transferred 3 decimals of land by registered deed No. 9438 and 9437 dated 19-7-1986. The defendant No. 7 by registered deed Nos. 9438 and 9437 sold 8 decimals of land to defendant No. 1, and 7 decimals of land to defendant No. 6, and 1 decimal of land to defendant No. 5 by 3 registered deeds of sale, all dated 19-7-1986. Defendant No. 5 constructed political office on his .01 acres of land and 7 decimals of the land of defendant No.6. Mahbuba sold her 14 decimals of land to defendant Nos. 8 to 10. Defendant No. 8 sold 1 (one) decimal of land to defendant No. 1. Defendant No. 7 constructed two shops on his 9 decimals of land. The defendants are possessing suit land by mutating their name. Defendant No. 7 did not sell the suit land to the plaintiff and he has no possession of the suit land for which the suit is liable to be dismissed.
